text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Uuuugh. Trainer, can I take a little 
break?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm just running on a little less 
sleep than usual. I was up late writing 
the comments for the flyers.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't a hard-working Falco cute too? 
*yaaawn*... Well then, good night...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dedication was admirable, but it 
seemed Smart Falcon wasn't getting proper 
rest...
